A note for the birthday girl

For my niece,
Nora Raye.

Hey, niece! Today is a special day—it’s your birthday! I just want to say I love you, and I hope you have a wonderful birthday. I’m so proud of the young lady you’re becoming.

I remember when you were first born. Your parents were so happy, and so were your sister Kobe and the rest of the family. We all were.

Continue being you in the best way possible. You are so cool, and I’m very glad to have you as my niece. Always remember: your Uncle B.T. loves you, always and forever.

Happy Birthday!
Love always, Uncle B.T. ♡
